heading: cyWhat is your landlord’s address?
headingHint: cyEnter the landlord’s address written on your notice proposing a new rent or tenancy agreement

hints.landlordPostcode: cyLeave blank if the address does not have one

landlordAddressLine1.required: cyEnter address line 1, typically the building and street
landlordAddressLine1.tooShort: cyAddress line 1 must be 2 characters or more

landlordAddressLine2.tooShort: cyAddress line 2 must be 2 characters or more

landlordPostTown.tooShort: cyTown or city must be 2 characters or more

landlordCounty.tooShort: cyCounty or region must be 2 characters or more

landlordCountry.tooShort: cyCountry must be 2 characters or more

landlordPostcode.tooShort: cyPostcode or area code must be 2 characters or more

errors.landlordAddressLine1MaxLength: cyAddress line 1 must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordAddressLine2MaxLength: cyAddress line 2 must be less than 100 characters or less
errors.landlordPostTownMaxLength: cyTown or city must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordCountyMaxLength: cyCounty or region must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordCountryMaxLength: cyCountry must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordPostcodeMaxLength: cyPostcode or area code must be 16 characters or less
